Markets.title: US stocks: US market ends slightly lower as bond yields hold near multi-decade highs
Markets.summary: US stocks closed slightly lower as consumer confidence fell to a 12-year low and government bond yields held near multi-decade highs. Investors reacted cautiously to declining job openings, pessimistic economic outlooks from households, and mixed signals from Federal Reserve officials ahead of new economic data.

Markets.title: Fed rate hike 'not urgent', says John Williams; Austan Goolsbee warns against 'playing with fire'
Markets.summary: New York Fed President John Williams stated the central bank could implement one more interest rate hike this year while awaiting further economic data. He also projected that inflation will end the year around 3.5% before reaching the Fed's target by 2028.

Markets.title: Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas divest over 68 lakh BSE shares worth Rs 2,186 crore ahead of Nifty 50 inclusion
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas sold 68.33 lakh shares of BSE for Rs 2,186.44 crore through bulk deals ahead of the company's Nifty 50 index inclusion. UTI Mutual Fund and Nippon India Mutual Fund bought 52.43 lakh of these shares, while BSE's stock closed 3.31% higher at Rs 3,200.

Markets.title: US 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.6%, reaching highest level since 2002
Markets.summary: The 30-year US Treasury yield surpassed 5.6%, reaching its highest level since 2002 amid a global bond selloff. This increase was driven by rising energy prices that fueled inflation fears, expectations for interest rate hikes, and heavy corporate bond issuance.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Nifty's indicative price suffered a sharp, temporary 2% drop during the monthly expiry closing auction before recovering. Analysts attribute current market pressures to crude volatility, high US Treasury yields, foreign institutional investor outflows, IPO fundraising, and geopolitical tensions.

Markets.title: CarMax's quarterly profit, revenue rise as pricing boosts used-car sales
Markets.summary: CarMax reported higher second-quarter profit and revenue on Tuesday. The used-car retailer used its pricing strategy to drive a sales rebound.

Geo-Political.title: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat
Geo-Political.summary: Spain has announced a ban on evictions following protests over the removal of an 87-year-old woman from her flat. Parliament must approve this ban and several related proposals within 30 days.

Geo-Political.title: South Africa to clean up high-risk areas after 12 women killed
Geo-Political.summary: Following the deaths of 12 women, South Africa will clean up high-risk areas to address the country's severe issue with violence against women. These killings sparked a national outcry and prompted government action to improve safety.

Geo-Political.title: Six Flags shuts down X2 rollercoaster after hundreds allege brain injuries
Geo-Political.summary: Six Flags has closed its X2 rollercoaster following multiple lawsuits from hundreds of riders. The plaintiffs allege that the spinning ride caused them to suffer brain injuries.

Geo-Political.title: 'I was lured into a trap': Evan Gershkovich on moment that led to 16 months in Russian jail
Geo-Political.summary: Freed U.S. journalist Evan Gershkovich stated he was lured into a trap that resulted in his 16-month imprisonment in Russia. He realized he was being used as a pawn in a larger geopolitical game because FSB agents did not interrogate or torture him.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli settlers set fire to two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the West Bank and blocked their return. The settlers also targeted Israeli security forces during the incident.

Geo-Political.title: More than 400 detained as France student protests escalate
Geo-Political.summary: More than 400 people have been detained during escalating student protests in France. The demonstrators are protesting against poor conditions and a lack of resources in high schools.

Data & Insights.title: China’s ‘10 million tonnes’ US coal bet is about more than energy: What Beijing gets from trade deal | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: China's commitment to buy 10 million tonnes of US coal provides American miners with a new export market. This agreement also helps Beijing offer strategic concessions during broader trade negotiations with Washington.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon wants fewer trade barriers with Europe. But there’s a catch
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon supports reducing trade barriers between the US and Europe. However, he stated that the European Union must first reform its economy, defense, and energy sectors.

Data & Insights.title: Shaktikanta Das flags eastward shift in global economy, urges Global South to seize opportunities
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das noted that the global economy is shifting eastward toward Asia. He urged nations in the Global South to focus on trade, energy, food security, and job creation to capitalize on this transition.

Data & Insights.title: RBI rate hikes: Nomura predicts only 50 bps against market’s 125 bps bet, anticipating moderation in inflation pressures
Data & Insights.summary: Nomura predicts the Reserve Bank of India will raise interest rates by only 50 basis points, which is significantly lower than the market's expectation of 125 bps. This modest forecast is based on the expectation that underlying inflation pressures will moderate.

Data & Insights.title: RBI drains $20 billion liquidity via FX operations: What it means for rupee, rates
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India drained nearly $20 billion from the financial system through foreign exchange operations, bond sales, and reverse repos. These measures significantly reduced the banking system's excess rupee liquidity surplus.

Data & Insights.title: Trade agreement can contribute to ‘better’ India-US ties, says Jaishankar as Piyush Goyal set to hold talks
Data & Insights.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that a trade agreement between India and the United States would enhance their bilateral relationship. His comments came as Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal prepared to hold trade talks, while acknowledging that negotiations have faced complex ground realities.

India.title: Zubeen Garg Death Case: 2 Security Officers Get Relief, But Remain In Jail
India.summary: Two security officers arrested in connection with Zubeen Garg's property and financial transactions have received some legal relief. However, they still remain in jail.

India.title: 5 New Sites Added To India's UNESCO Tentative List For World Heritage
India.summary: India has added five new sites to UNESCO's tentative list for World Heritage. One of these sites is the Udayagiri hills in Madhya Pradesh, which features rock-cut monuments built under Gupta patronage during the late 4th and early 5th centuries.

India.title: Local Shiv Sena (UBT) Leader Dies In Thane After Firing By Unidentified Men
India.summary: A local Shiv Sena (UBT) leader named Purnekar was shot dead by unidentified men in Thane. At the time of his death, he served as the division head or 'vibhag pramukh' for Uddhav Thackeray's party.

India.title: No Mother-Child Photo On Baby Food Packets, Orders Team Tukaram Mundhe
India.summary: Indian official Tukaram Mundhe has banned mother-child photos on baby food packaging. He also ordered manufacturers to print the "Mother's Milk Is Best" message on all their products.

India.title: Delhi Bans Bus Strikes For 6 Months, Commuters Get Relief
India.summary: The Delhi government has banned bus strikes for six months by invoking the Essential Services Maintenance Act. This decision provides relief to daily commuters by ensuring uninterrupted public transport services.

India.title: Noida Gang Rape Survivor Tried To Escape, Bus Conductor Locked Door: Cops
India.summary: A minor girl boarded a bus in Greater Noida on August 4 after being falsely told it was heading to Noida Sector 63. During the subsequent gang rape, the survivor tried to escape, but the bus conductor locked the door.

General.title: Burnham vows to end existing pension triple lock in 2030 to help fund care
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham has pledged to end the state pension triple lock in 2030. He announced this policy during a conference speech to help fund future care costs.

General.title: Chris Mason: Burnham delivers deeply political speech with a personal core
General.summary: BBC political editor Chris Mason describes Andy Burnham's speech as both deeply political and personally emotional. The address combined the tone of a potential future prime minister with the grief of a mourning son.

General.title: 'Quantity of petrol' but no explosives found in three vehicles near RAF Fairford
General.summary: Police say the decision to release five men on bail is one "grounded in experience and strategy".

General.title: How did the RAF Fairford incident go from 'suspected bomb plot' to police bail?
General.summary: Detectives are investigating the RAF Fairford incident as a vital stage of the inquiry remains open with multiple possibilities. The suspect was released on police bail while the investigation continues.

General.title: Household energy bills forecast to see biggest rise in four years
General.summary: A typical household's annual gas and electricity bill is forecast to rise to £1,999 starting in January. This projected increase marks the largest jump in household energy bills in four years.

General.title: Three teenagers die after car enters River Wear
General.summary: Police recovered the bodies of two teenage boys and a teenage girl from the River Wear. The three teenagers died after the car they were in entered the water.
